mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT msm.FACTORY_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_CODE, msm.MATERIAL_DESC, msm.MOULD_CODE, msm.MAIN_PATTERN, mmi.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, mmi.MOULD_TYPE, mmi.MOULD_STATUS, mmi.SHELL_STANDARD, mmi.LOGISTICS_STATUS, '01' AS RELATION_TYPE FROM t_mdm_sku_mould_rel msm LEFT JOIN t_mdm_model_info mmi ON mmi.FACTORY_CODE = msm.FACTORY_CODE AND mmi.MOULD_CODE = msm.MOULD_CODE AND IFNULL(mmi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(msm.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND msm.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND msm.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND msm.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE)

SELECT DISTINCT mdp.FACTORY_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_CODE, mdp.MATERIAL_DESC, mdp.MOULD_CODE, '' AS MAIN_PATTERN, mdp.MOULD_CODE AS BASE_MOULD_CODE, '' AS MOULD_TYPE, 1 AS MOULD_STATUS, '' AS SHELL_STANDARD, 1 AS LOGISTICS_STATUS, '02' AS RELATION_TYPE FROM t_mp_mould_delivery_plan mdp WHERE IFNULL(mdp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mdp.BOARDING_DATE >= #{productionStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND mdp.BOARDING_DATE <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mdp.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND mdp.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE)
